governance_decisions.blocking_reason: Changing the duration impacts the master, build plan, Build-12, Build-13, merge gates, tests, and promotion semantics.
governance_decisions.rule_until_decided: Keep the canon at 7 days and treat 15 days as a change request, not as an automatic markdown correction.

governance_decisions.current_canon: The LIGHT shadow truth phase activated A/B/C/D and Build-14 at 100%, which created ambiguity with the COMPLETE rollout envelope.
governance_decisions.proposed_change: Reserve COMPLETE for the rollout envelope only, and name the Build-11 full-observation phase 'Shadow intégral'.
governance_decisions.rule_until_decided: Use 'Shadow intégral' for the LIGHT shadow truth phase. Do not use 'solution complète' or 'shadow complet' when the intent is the Build-11 LIGHT shadow with all components active in observation.

targeted_audits.scope: Build-11 / Build-12 / Build-13 Shadow gate semantics
targeted_audits.conclusion: The official rule is not '30 days only'. It is 30 consecutive shadow days plus a complete/exploitable shadow report and post-shadow component verdicts before promotion.
targeted_audits.code_mapping: shadow_report_ready is the runtime representation of the canonical 'rapport shadow exploitable/complet' requirement.
targeted_audits.action_taken: Regression tests expecting 30-days-only behavior must be updated.

targeted_audits.scope: Build-1 -> Build-14 critical audit execution plan
targeted_audits.conclusion: The audit must proceed in structured waves: base architecture, Light rollout core, promotion gates, Build-14 enablers, then transversal consolidation.
targeted_audits.action_taken: Use the plan as the execution frame and update memory after each audit wave.

targeted_audits.conclusion: Build-2, Build-3 and Build-5 are aligned in the current evidence frame. Build-1 is still partial because global DAG validation fails. Build-4 is still partial because its canonical modules look green but the package-level circuit breaker suite is not clean in this environment.
targeted_audits.action_taken: Open a targeted Build-1 dependency audit and keep Build-4 under test-environment scrutiny.

targeted_audits.conclusion: Build-6, Build-7, Build-8, Build-9 and Build-10 are aligned in the current evidence frame.
targeted_audits.action_taken: Use this green Light-core baseline before consolidating Build-11 to Build-14.

targeted_audits.conclusion: Build-11 remains still partial, Build-12 and Build-13 are not ready, and Build-14 remains still partial. Gates are strict and mostly aligned with canon, but doctrinal closure and exposed-state consistency are not complete.
targeted_audits.action_taken: Keep downstream promotions blocked and open a targeted correction wave on Build-11 closure and Build-14 exposed-state normalization.

targeted_audits.conclusion: The two primary critical fronts are the Build-1 architectural DAG drift and the incomplete closure of the Shadow-to-live chain around Build-11 and Build-14.
targeted_audits.action_taken: Prioritize corrections in the order: Build-1 DAG, Build-11 closure, Build-14 exposed-state normalization, then downstream requalification.

targeted_audits.scope: Git build-branch map and integration status for Build-1 to Build-14
targeted_audits.conclusion: Local checkpoint branches do exist for Builds 2 to 14, but every inspected tip is already integrated into main and the current branch. Build-1 has no dedicated checkpoint branch and is mainly anchored by the initial commit plus later integrated work.
targeted_audits.action_taken: Treat the current dirty worktree as the real unsafeguarded area. Do not use old checkpoint branches as the primary recovery base.
